schema.description: Request body for creating or updating a Company by your own company ID.

name.description: Company name. It renames the Company when it differs.

joinCode.description: A 6-character code for the Company's customers, used only when the Company is created and only when no other Company has it. Otherwise Voucherly generates one.

allOf.description: Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format. It can contain up to 10 key-value items with a maximum length of 40 for the key and of 400 chars for the value.
allOf.title: Metadata

metadata.description: The whole set of fields of the Company, with the limits of the Customer. A key left out is removed, and an empty object removes them all. Without it the saved fields stay. Two keys that differ only in case are one key, and answer 400.

schema.title: UpsertCompanyRequest

Default.summary: Create or update a company by your own company ID

Fields.summary: Create or update a company with its fields
